notes: All files referenced are relative to data/gov/. Extracted record arrays for large lists are stored in separate JSON files (see extractedRecordsFile) with a small inline sample here. No entries were fabricated; all records were parsed from official MMMD pages/PDFs. mmmd.gov.zm serves an invalid TLS certificate chain; downloads were made with certificate verification disabled.

revocations.event: Mass cancellation of non-compliant mining and non-mining rights by the Mining Licensing Committee (MLC), 78th meeting
revocations.date: 2024-04-02 (notice; cancellations decided at MLC 78th meeting, following default notices circulated 2023-10-24)
revocations.authority: Mining Licensing Committee / Mining Cadastre Department, Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development (MMMD)
revocations.reason: Non-compliance with conditions of grant of mining and non-mining rights (Section 72, Mines and Minerals Development Act No. 11 of 2015); holders failed to take remedial measures after 24 Oct 2023 default notices

revocations.event: Government press statement: 3,000 mining licenses cancelled for non-compliance since 2024 (cadastre clean-up ahead of Minerals Regulation Commission transition); 1,200 holders appealed
revocations.authority: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development / Mining Cadastre Department (Permanent Secretary Dr. Hapenga M. Kabeta)
revocations.reason: Failure to meet conditions prescribed under the Mines and Minerals Development Act; part of reform/clean-up of the national mining register focused on critical minerals
revocations.note: Press statement only; no consolidated downloadable list of the 3,000 was published with it. The MLC 78th-meeting list (2,604 records, see above) is the largest published component of these cancellations.

revocations.event: Revocation of mining rights granted inside Mopani Copper Mines PLC large-scale mining licence 7073-HQ-LML, Mufulira District
revocations.authority: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development (announced by Principal Public Relations Officer Shamwinda Tembo)
revocations.count: at least 3 named rights plus additional unspecified holders
revocations.reason: Failure by affected licence holders to obtain required mining consents from Mopani Copper Mines PLC; holders ordered to surrender licences to Director of Mining Cadastre

extractedRecords.holder: Zambia Federation of Co-operatives in Mining Society Limited

revocations.note: No official list found on mmmd.gov.zm; anchored via News Diggers report quoting the ministry statement.

revocations.event: PRECURSOR (default, not yet cancellation): Default notice for non-compliance to conditions of grant of mining and non-mining rights
revocations.reason: Failure to register pegging certificates, pay area charges, submit annual reports / production returns / future programmes, commence operations (Section 72(2), MMDA 2015) - holders given 30 days to show cause; most were cancelled at MLC 78th meeting (see above)

revocations.event: PRECURSOR (default, not yet cancellation): MLC defaults 3,429 mining and non-mining rights - final public default notice (30 days to show cause why licenses should not be revoked)
revocations.authority: Mining Licensing Committee / Mining Cadastre Department, MMMD (Director Samuel C. Maango)
revocations.reason: 11 categories of breach incl. non-payment of area charges, non-registration of pegging certificate, non-submission of quarterly/annual reports and production returns, failure to commence operations, non-payment into Environmental Protection Fund (Section 72, MMDA 2015)
listFields: breach section (A-E) parsed from PDF headings
revocations.extractedRecordsNote: 4,891 rows parsed across 5 breach sections; 3,278 unique license codes (licenses in breach of multiple conditions appear in more than one section; official headline count is 3,429).

revocations.event: PRESS-ONLY ANCHOR: ~800 mine licences reported revoked (Daily Nation, Zambia)
revocations.authority: Ministry of Mines and Minerals Development (reported)
revocations.note: No official downloadable list found online; MMMD website archive does not go back that far.

revocationDataGaps: No revocation/cancellation list published by the Minerals Regulation Commission (MRC, operational since June 2025) was found; mrc.gov.zm does not resolve and the MRC appears to have no standalone website as of July 2026. MRC-era actions surface only through MMMD pages and press.
No published list itemizing the full 3,000 licenses referenced in the 2025-02-06 press statement.

None of the published revocation/default lists include coordinates, districts, or commodity fields - only license code and holder name. Coordinates must be joined via the cadastre GIS layers using the license CODE field.
Government Gazette scans (gazettes.africa hosts Zambia gazettes through ~2025) were checked via search; no specific mining-licence revocation gazette PDF was identified.

MLC meeting results pages (e.g. https://www.mmmd.gov.zm/?p=2618, 75th meeting, 437 table rows) cover application grants/rejections/deferrals rather than revocations; downloaded (mmmd_p2618.html) but not extracted.

gisSources.name: Zambia Mining Cadastre Map Portal (MMMD, Trimble Landfolio)
gisSources.url: https://portals.landfolio.com/zambia/ (ArcGIS REST backend https://ags1.landfolio.com/arcgis/rest/services/ZambiaMapPortal/, token-protected but publicly reachable through the portal's session proxy portals.landfolio.com/zambia/proxy.ashx)
gisSources.format: GeoJSON (EPSG:4326), paged ArcGIS REST query exports
gisSources.fields: Code, Type, TypeCode, Status, StatusGrp, Parties (holder+%), ApplNo, DteApplied/DtePegged/DteGranted/DteExpires/DteRenewal, AreaValue/AreaUnit, Commodities, Region, polygon geometry (46 fields total)
gisSources.terms: Official public map portal of the Ministry of Mines; no explicit open-data license published. Portal front page notes Landfolio system upgrade v7.2->7.5 (Mar 2026).

gisSources.name: NGDR - National Geospatial Data Register / Public GIS Data Portal (Geological Survey Department, gsb.gov.zm)
gisSources.fields: code, type, status (incl. 261 'Non-Compliant'), statusgrp, jurisdic, region, dteapplied/dtegranted/dteexpires, parties, commodities, MultiPolygon geometry
gisSources.additionalLayersAvailableNotDownloaded: forestry concessions/permits, national forests, Lusaka townships, wards, lakes, water pipes, MLNR lots (27 WFS feature types total)
gisSources.terms: Open WFS/WMS, no authentication, no explicit license text found.

gisSources.name: MMMD website Downloads / Geological Maps pages
gisSources.contents: Policy documents (National Critical Minerals Strategy 2024-2028, Mineral Resources Development Policy 2022, statistical bulletin, brochures). Geological maps pages list map products for purchase from Geological Survey - no open coordinate schedules or shapefiles.
gisSources.terms: Public documents; geological map sheets are sold, not openly downloadable.

gisSources.name: Zambia Data Hub / NSDI ArcGIS Hub (Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources + ZamStats + GRID3)
gisSources.contents: UNAVAILABLE as of 2026-07-23: hub returns 404 / 'SB_0005: Subscription is disabled'.

gisSources.contents: Both reachable (HTTP 200) but no mining/license/geology downloads located; GeoNetwork query for 'mining' returned no records.
